4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.film_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as film_revenue
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        fr.film_revenue,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor fa2 WHERE fa2.film_id = fa.film_id) as num_actors
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
actor_top3 AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        film_revenue,
        num_actors,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY film_revenue DESC) as film_rank
    FROM actor_film_revenue
),
actor_top3_with_per_actor_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        film_revenue,
        num_actors,
        film_rank,
        film_revenue / num_actors as revenue_per_actor_in_film
    FROM actor_top3
    WHERE film_rank <= 3
),
actor_top3_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        SUM(revenue_per_actor_in_film) as avg_revenue_per_actor_in_top3_films
    FROM actor_top3_with_per_actor_revenue
    GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT 
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    t.film_id,
    f.title,
    ROUND(t.film_revenue, 2) as film_revenue,
    t.num_actors,
    ROUND(t.revenue_per_actor_in_film, 2) as revenue_per_actor_in_film,
    ROUND(s.avg_revenue_per_actor_in_top3_films, 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor_in_top3_film

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.actor_id) as num_actors, SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN inventory inv ON f.film_id = inv.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON inv.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.total_revenue,
        fr.num_actors,
        fr.total_revenue * 1.0 / fr.num_actors as avg_revenue_per_actor
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        total_revenue,
        num_actors,
        avg_revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) as rank
    FROM actor_film_revenue
)
SELECT 
    r.actor_id,
    r.first_name,
    r.last_name,
    f.title,
    r.film_id,
    r.total_revenue,
    r.num_actors,
    r.avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked r
JOIN film f ON r.film_id = f.film_id
WHERE r.rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.actor_id, r.total_revenue DESC
